description: Duplicate shared IP trends. **Snapshot details** table first. **IP↔server (edge = snapshot time)**: bipartite graph; IP nodes blue, server nodes amber; **edges** multi-colored by snapshot+IP. **IP↔server (latest update)**: same styling for latest snapshot only. **Server↔IP** node chart: server pairs sharing an IP (latest snapshot). Filters: Proxy scope, **Duplicate IP** (JSON_TABLE), **Server name** (multi-select `IN ($server_name)` like other MySQL variables).

panels.description: **dup_scope**: cross-server = IP shared across ≥2 server labels; same-server-only = duplicate phones under one label only.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  s.captured_at,
  s.last_ip,
  COUNT(DISTINCT s.server_label) AS server_count,
  CASE
    WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT s.server_label) > 1 THEN 'cross-server'
    ELSE 'same-server-only'
  END AS dup_scope,
  GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT s.server_label ORDER BY s.server_label SEPARATOR ', ') AS servers,
  MAX(x.sibling_phones) AS phones_on_this_ip
FROM duplicate_ip_snapshot_servers s
INNER JOIN duplicate_ip_snapshot_rows x
  ON x.captured_at = s.captured_at
  AND x.proxy_status_scope = s.proxy_status_scope
  AND x.last_ip = s.last_ip
WHERE s.proxy_status_scope = '${proxy_scope}'
  AND $__timeFilter(s.captured_at)
  AND (
    '${duplicate_ip:raw}' IN ('$__all', '')
    OR EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM JSON_TABLE(
        CAST('${duplicate_ip:json}' AS JSON),
        '$[*]' COLUMNS (ip VARCHAR(64) PATH '$')
      ) AS dup_ip
      WHERE dup_ip.ip = s.last_ip
    )
  )
  AND (
    '${server_name:raw}' IN ('$__all', '')
    OR s.server_label IN ($server_name)
  )
GROUP BY s.captured_at, s.last_ip
ORDER BY s.captured_at DESC, dup_scope DESC, s.last_ip
LIMIT 800

panels.title: Snapshot details

panels.description: **Bipartite graph**: **IP** and **server** nodes (`ip:` / `srv:`). Each **edge** = one row; **mainstat** = snapshot time. Uses **all** captures in the range. **Styling**: all IP nodes **#2563EB**, all server nodes **#C2410C**; **edges** are multi-colored (hash by time + IP + server). Force layout. Narrow the time picker if slow.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  CONCAT(
    UNIX_TIMESTAMP(s.captured_at),
    '-',
    REPLACE(REPLACE(s.last_ip, ':', '_'), '.', '_'),
    '-',
    s.server_label
  ) AS id,
  CONCAT('ip:', s.last_ip) AS `source`,
  CONCAT('srv:', s.server_label) AS `target`,
  DATE_FORMAT(s.captured_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS mainstat,
  s.proxy_status_scope AS secondarystat,
  ELT(
    1 + (ABS(CRC32(CONCAT(s.captured_at, s.last_ip, s.server_label))) MOD 12),
    '#5B8FF9',
    '#61DDAA',
    '#65789B',
    '#F6BD16',
    '#7262FD',
    '#78D3F8',
    '#9661BC',
    '#F6903D',
    '#008685',
    '#F08BB4',
    '#9E87FF',
    '#58D5FF'
  ) AS color,
  1 AS thickness
FROM duplicate_ip_snapshot_servers s
WHERE s.proxy_status_scope = '${proxy_scope}'
  AND $__timeFilter(s.captured_at)
  AND (
    '${duplicate_ip:raw}' IN ('$__all', '')
    OR EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM JSON_TABLE(
        CAST('${duplicate_ip:json}' AS JSON),
        '$[*]' COLUMNS (ip VARCHAR(64) PATH '$')
      ) AS dup_ip
      WHERE dup_ip.ip = s.last_ip
    )
  )
  AND (
    '${server_name:raw}' IN ('$__all', '')
    OR s.server_label IN ($server_name)
  )
ORDER BY s.captured_at DESC, s.last_ip, s.server_label
LIMIT 8000

WITH ip_nodes AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CONCAT('ip:', s.last_ip) AS id,
    s.last_ip AS title,
    'IP' AS subtitle,
    '#2563EB' AS color,
    46 AS nodeRadius
  FROM duplicate_ip_snapshot_servers s
  WHERE s.proxy_status_scope = '${proxy_scope}'
    AND $__timeFilter(s.captured_at)
    AND (
      '${duplicate_ip:raw}' IN ('$__all', '')
      OR EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM JSON_TABLE(
          CAST('${duplicate_ip:json}' AS JSON),
          '$[*]' COLUMNS (ip VARCHAR(64) PATH '$')
        ) AS dup_ip
        WHERE dup_ip.ip = s.last_ip
      )
    )
  AND (
    '${server_name:raw}' IN ('$__all', '')
    OR s.server_label IN ($server_name)
  )
),
srv_nodes AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CONCAT('srv:', s.server_label) AS id,
    s.server_label AS title,
    'server' AS subtitle,
    '#C2410C' AS color,
    40 AS nodeRadius
  FROM duplicate_ip_snapshot_servers s
  WHERE s.proxy_status_scope = '${proxy_scope}'
    AND $__timeFilter(s.captured_at)
    AND (
      '${duplicate_ip:raw}' IN ('$__all', '')
      OR EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM JSON_TABLE(
          CAST('${duplicate_ip:json}' AS JSON),
          '$[*]' COLUMNS (ip VARCHAR(64) PATH '$')
        ) AS dup_ip
        WHERE dup_ip.ip = s.last_ip
      )
    )
  AND (
    '${server_name:raw}' IN ('$__all', '')
    OR s.server_label IN ($server_name)
  )
),
all_nodes AS (
  SELECT * FROM ip_nodes
  UNION ALL
  SELECT * FROM srv_nodes
)
SELECT * FROM all_nodes
UNION ALL
SELECT
  '__nodata__' AS id,
  'No data in range' AS title,
  '' AS subtitle,
  '#94a3b8' AS color,
  36 AS nodeRadius
FROM DUAL
WHERE (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM all_nodes) = 0

panels.title: IP ↔ server (latest update)

panels.description: **Nodes** query uses a CTE + placeholder row when there are no servers in scope, so the nodes frame always has a valid `id` and Grafana does not throw on empty data. Placeholder shows **No data in range** as a single grey node when there is nothing to draw. **Edges** may still be empty; that is OK when paired with this nodes frame. **Layered** layout; edge **color** / **thickness** by shared IP. MySQL 8+ (CTE + JSON_TABLE).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  CONCAT(
    UNIX_TIMESTAMP(a.captured_at),
    '-',
    REPLACE(REPLACE(a.last_ip, ':', '_'), '.', '_'),
    '-',
    a.server_label,
    '-',
    b.server_label
  ) AS id,
  a.server_label AS `source`,
  b.server_label AS `target`,
  a.last_ip AS mainstat,
  ELT(
    1 + (ABS(CRC32(a.last_ip)) MOD 12),
    '#5B8FF9',
    '#61DDAA',
    '#65789B',
    '#F6BD16',
    '#7262FD',
    '#78D3F8',
    '#9661BC',
    '#F6903D',
    '#008685',
    '#F08BB4',
    '#9E87FF',
    '#58D5FF'
  ) AS color,
  2 AS thickness
FROM duplicate_ip_snapshot_servers a
INNER JOIN duplicate_ip_snapshot_servers b
  ON a.last_ip = b.last_ip
  AND a.captured_at = b.captured_at
  AND a.proxy_status_scope = b.proxy_status_scope
  AND a.server_label < b.server_label
WHERE a.proxy_status_scope = '${proxy_scope}'
  AND a.captured_at = (
    SELECT MAX(x.captured_at)
    FROM duplicate_ip_snapshot_servers x
    WHERE x.proxy_status_scope = '${proxy_scope}'
      AND $__timeFilter(x.captured_at)
      AND (
        '${server_name:raw}' IN ('$__all', '')
        OR x.server_label IN ($server_name)
      )
  )
  AND (
    '${duplicate_ip:raw}' IN ('$__all', '')
    OR EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM JSON_TABLE(
        CAST('${duplicate_ip:json}' AS JSON),
        '$[*]' COLUMNS (ip VARCHAR(64) PATH '$')
      ) AS dup_ip
      WHERE dup_ip.ip = a.last_ip
    )
  )
  AND (
    '${server_name:raw}' IN ('$__all', '')
    OR a.server_label IN ($server_name)
    OR b.server_label IN ($server_name)
  )
ORDER BY a.captured_at ASC, a.last_ip, a.server_label, b.server_label
LIMIT 2000

WITH snap_nodes AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    s.server_label AS id,
    s.server_label AS title,
    'server' AS subtitle,
    '#C2410C' AS color,
    40 AS nodeRadius
  FROM duplicate_ip_snapshot_servers s
  WHERE s.proxy_status_scope = '${proxy_scope}'
    AND s.captured_at = (
      SELECT MAX(x.captured_at)
      FROM duplicate_ip_snapshot_servers x
      WHERE x.proxy_status_scope = '${proxy_scope}'
        AND $__timeFilter(x.captured_at)
        AND (
          '${server_name:raw}' IN ('$__all', '')
          OR x.server_label IN ($server_name)
        )
    )
    AND (
      '${duplicate_ip:raw}' IN ('$__all', '')
      OR EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM JSON_TABLE(
          CAST('${duplicate_ip:json}' AS JSON),
          '$[*]' COLUMNS (ip VARCHAR(64) PATH '$')
        ) AS dup_ip
        WHERE dup_ip.ip = s.last_ip
      )
    )
  AND (
    '${server_name:raw}' IN ('$__all', '')
    OR s.server_label IN ($server_name)
  )
  ORDER BY s.server_label
  LIMIT 500
)
SELECT * FROM snap_nodes
UNION ALL
SELECT
  '__nodata__' AS id,
  'No data in range' AS title,
  '' AS subtitle,
  '#94a3b8' AS color,
  36 AS nodeRadius
FROM DUAL
WHERE (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM snap_nodes) = 0
